clips.title: The story
paras: Posted on the Tarren Mill bounty board under the authority of Lady Sylvanas, this decree condemns all members of the Syndicate to death. The Forsaken seek to purge the brigands gathering in the ruins of Durnholde Keep before they threaten Horde operations in the foothills.

The Syndicate's sudden presence southeast of Tarren Mill has not gone unnoticed by the Forsaken. Rather than offering parley or treating them as mere displaced nobles, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her commanders view the Syndicate as an active pestilence. The bounty dictates immediate death, specifying that any prisoners brought in will be executed without trial.

Once an infamous internment camp fortress, Durnholde Keep now lies shattered and lawless. Syndicate Rogues and Watchmen have crept into its crumbled ramparts and towers, using the historic stronghold as an operations hub. For High Executor Darthalia, ridding the ruins of these armed bandits is essential to securing the road and safeguarding Tarren Mill's southeastern approach.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.
A handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have nothing better to do than stand here before me, adventurer? As High Executor, I have more pressing matters than to stare at your rotting visage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, adventurer. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
